div.head: Af 6
div.ab: VII. Gif hwa on cirican hwæt geþeofige, forgylde ðæt angylde, ⁊ þæt wíte swa to þam angylde belimpan wille, ⁊ slea mon þa hond of ðe he hit mid [stæl] dyde.
VII. Gif hwa on cirican hwæt geðeofige, forgylde þæt angylde, ⁊ ðæt wite swa to ðam angylde belimpan wille, ⁊ slea mon þa hond óf ðe he hit mid gedyde.
Be ðam ðe steleð on ciricean. Gyf hwá on cyricean hwæt geþeofige, forgylde þæt angylde, ⁊ þæt wite swa to ðam angylde gelimpan wylle, ⁊ slea mon ða hand óf, ðe he hit mid gedyde.
Si quis in ecclesia furetur aliquid, restituat hoc semel, et forisfactum, sicut ad angildum pertinet, et amputetur ei manus de qua furatus est.
{VII} Gif hwa on cirican hwæt geðeofige, forgylde þæt angylde, ⁊ ðæt wite swa to ðam angylde belimpan wille, ⁊ slea mon þa hond óf ðe he hit mid gedyde.
If someone steals something from a church, let him pay for it single-fold, and the fine such as is appropriate to the single-payment, and let the hand be struck off with which he did it.

If anyone steals anything from a church, he shall pay the value of the article and the fine which is appropriate to the the value in question, and the hand shall be struck off which committed the theft.
If anyone steals anything in church, he is to pay the simple compensation and the fine normally belonging to that simple compensation, and the hand with which he did it is to be struck off.
Wenn jemand in der Kirche etwas stiehlt, vergelte er das mit einfachem Ersatz; und das Strafgeld, wie es zu jenem Ersatz gehören möge; und schlage man die Hand ab, womit er es gethan hat.
If someone steals anything in a church, let him repay it with single compensation, and the fine as may belong to that compensation; and let the hand with which he did it be struck off.
